headline: 606 asteroids screened against the radiation momentum ceiling; 30 (4.95%) exceed it, 7 of those are reliably fitted and not already identified; a log-normal core fit of the ordinary population expects 0.0003

cuts.criterion: at least one of A1/A2/A3 fitted and non-zero
a measured diameter, or an H from which one can be derived
observed arc >= 3650 d (a decade; Yarkovsky needs many apparitions)

cut_ledger.note: `n_failing_alone` ignores every other cut; `n_removed_in_sequence` is what this cut removed after the ones above it.  The two differ wherever the cuts are correlated, which for orbit quality they heavily are.

tail_expectation_all_screened.note: the log-normal is a REFERENCE for what an ordinary thermal-recoil population looks like, not a theory of one; a Poisson p here carries no trials correction and is descriptive
